title: Part History search shows only the matching bin rows
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Bin-1], [Bin-2] = two bin locations; [Part-A] = tracked part stocked in both, with one entry whose row is split by bin.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Settings → Bin Locations and add two bins (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BINA" and "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BINB"). [Bin-1], [Bin-2] = those names.
  2. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BINS PART), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BINS-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  3. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BINS-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BINS PART).
  4. Open [Part-A], click "+ Add Bin Location" twice and set [Bin-1] quantity 4 and [Bin-2] quantity 3; Save.
  5. Open [Part-A] again, change [Bin-1] to 6 and [Bin-2] to 5 in the same edit; Save.
  6. [Staff-1] = [Admin]'s name as Part History shows it.
  7. Check the setup worked: [Part-A]'s Part History has one entry whose row lists both [Bin-1] and [Bin-2]. If the two bins were written as two separate entries, note it and use the last one.
custom_steps:
1. Open [Part-A]'s Part History.
  2. Type [Bin-1] in the search.
  3. Replace it with [Staff-1]'s name.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The entry shows only its [Bin-1] row; the [Bin-2] row is hidden.
  • Step 3: The entry shows both bin rows.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S10-R28, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas none. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).
